title: The Spot model on the floating base of Robot, ANYmal and the Mars rover imported
author: Claude-JG
description: spotModel.py builds Spot by its own code. Decided: adapted to the floating base of Robot; ANYmal and the Mars rover imported the same way.
releaseNotes: The example quadrupedsFloatingBase.py has ANYmal and Spot on floating bases in one model, with contact at their feet. The Mars rover is not added, as it has no license file.
